Define the zero-control Gaussian law once on P union 2P and use the R-128 fixed-law affine predictable controls h_[2p]=t_p H_p xi_[p], where each control reads its distinct raw source innovation. The terminal sixth-power Hessian is retained and dropped only as one global positive-semidefinite form, not assigned the factor-three graph. A separately declared shifted-state p:2p:4p companion has one bilinear GH connection with support {+/-3p,+/-5p}; its endpoint and sextic first-variation connections vanish only at the declared all-zero stationary covariance-matched origin.
